summary: Fisherman in a small pontoon boat was pushed over the Bear Lake spillway in the Flat Tops and was found deceased in a section of the Bear River
location: Bear Lake / Bear River, Flat Tops
responding_agency: Garfield County SAR; Routt County SAR (mutual aid); Yampa Fire Protection District; Routt County Sheriff; Colorado Parks and Wildlife; Garfield County Coroner
notes: Per Far Routt Newsletter June 16-17, 2024 "Recovery in the Flat Tops": RCSAR assisted at the Garfield County Coroner's Office request. Stillwater dam outflow was shut down; responders rigged a guiding line with ropes/pulleys on both riverbanks to recover the body, then a second rope system to bring him up the steep embankment. The pontoon boat and personal effects were recovered the following day. County left blank: coroner's mutual-aid request implies Garfield County jurisdiction but Bear Lake/Bear River location is near the county line and unconfirmed. Date is the newsletter's June 16-17, 2024 recovery window; the spill-over date itself is unknown (DATE APPROXIMATE).
